tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// de'i lung sbyor bzhugs/ ༄༅// 'dis ni rdo rje mnyes par 'gyur// ye shes me yis rab dgyes bya// rgyal ba phan pa mnyes pa dang*// gser gyi mnga' bdag mnyes pa dang*// pad+ma gar dbang mnyes pa dang*// lcags mchog dbang po mnyes pa dang*// tshangs pa brgya byin dbang chen dang*// khyab 'jug rlung dang me chen dang*// thong ldan nyid dang 'dod lha dang*// zla ba nyi ma gdon gzhan dang*// sa ni zhags pa 'dzin pa dang*// lus ngan de bzhin mtshams skyong dang*// chos rgyal dang ni klu dang ni// dri za lha min mi'am ci// sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pa'i lha// 'og min du ni gnas pa dang*// gang zhig rgyal chen gnas pa dang*// gzhan 'phrul dbang sgyur nyid dang ni// 'phrul dga' yi ni lha rnams dang*// gang zhig dag pa'i gnas son dang*// 'od zer 'jig rten khams gnas dang*// mi mjed khams gsum gnas pa dang*// snod dang sems can 'jig rten dang*// lcug ma'i tshogs dang rtswa sogs dang*// gang zhig rab dga'i sar gnas dang*// pha rol dri med gang phyin dang*// 'od 'phro can du gnas pa dang*// mi g.yo'i gnas su byas pa dang*// gang zhig chos sprin rjes song dang*// gang zhig sbyang dkar son pa dang*// gang zhig ring song thob pa dang*// 'od byed du ni gnas pa ste// sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon po dang*// 'phags pa'i gang zag brgyad po dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang nyan thos nyid// rwa ni ral gri'i gzugs can dang*// dmyal ba yi dwags byol song dang*// lha dang lha min mi rnams ni// sbyin sreg cho gas dgyes pa nyid// de nyid tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor lo// bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya mtsho rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// zhes rdo rje gur las gsungs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
